description: Validates the test environment is ready: CLI connectivity, vault file operations, frontmatter, search, plugin activation, health check, EventBus, commands, and services.

teardown.title: Set installer-done gate flag if vault already installed
teardown.description: In skip mode (vault already installed), sets _e2eInstallerDone so downstream journey tests can proceed without running the installer.

actions.code: (() => { if ('{{installerMode}}' === 'skip' && String(window._e2ePrerequisitesPassed) === 'true') { window._e2eInstallerDone = true; } return 'ok'; })()
actions.description: Conditionally set _e2eInstallerDone when vault already installed

steps.title: CLI can reach Obsidian
steps.description: Verifies the Obsidian CLI can execute JavaScript in the running Obsidian instance. This is the foundation — every subsequent test depends on CLI connectivity.
steps.expectedInput: Obsidian running with the test vault open

steps.title: Vault accepts file operations
steps.description: Creates a test markdown file, reads it back, and verifies the content matches. Confirms the CLI-to-vault file I/O pipeline works.
steps.expectedOutput: Created file content matches on read-back

actions.description: Create test file via vault API

actions.code: (async () => { const f = app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath('03 - Resources/Test Data/prereq-crud.md'); if (!f) throw new Error('File not found after create'); const content = await app.vault.read(f); if (!content.includes('E2E CRUD Test')) throw new Error('Content mismatch: ' + content.substring(0, 100)); return 'ok'; })()
actions.description: Read file back and verify content

steps.title: Frontmatter properties persist
steps.description: Creates a file with YAML frontmatter, sets a property via processFrontMatter, reads the file back and verifies the property was written.
steps.expectedOutput: Property 'status: verified' appears in file content

actions.code:
(async () => { await app.vault.create('03 - Resources/Test Data/prereq-fm.md', '---
type: test
---
# Frontmatter Test'); return 'ok'; })()

(async () => { const f = app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath('03 - Resources/Test Data/prereq-fm.md'); if (!f) throw new Error('File not found'); await app.fileManager.processFrontMatter(f, (fm) => { fm.status = 'verified'; }); return 'ok'; })()

(async () => { const f = app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath('03 - Resources/Test Data/prereq-fm.md'); if (!f) throw new Error('File not found'); const content = await app.vault.read(f); if (!content.includes('verified')) throw new Error('Frontmatter property not found after set'); return 'ok'; })()

steps.title: Vault search indexes content
steps.description: Creates a file with a unique token, then searches for it. Verifies Obsidian's search index picks up new content.
steps.expectedOutput: Search returns at least one result for the unique token

actions.code: (() => { const token = 'prereq-search-' + Date.now(); window._e2eSearchToken = token; return token; })()
(async () => { await app.vault.create('03 - Resources/Test Data/prereq-search.md', '# Search\n' + window._e2eSearchToken); return 'ok'; })()

(() => { const token = window._e2eSearchToken; const results = Object.keys(app.metadataCache.getCache?.('03 - Resources/Test Data/prereq-search.md') ?? {}); if (results.length === 0) { const fileExists = !!app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath('03 - Resources/Test Data/prereq-search.md'); if (!fileExists) throw new Error('Search test file not found'); } return 'ok'; })()
actions.description: Verify file is indexed by metadata cache

steps.title: Prepare installer state
steps.description: In installer mode: disables plugin, resets installer state in data.json, and removes seed files via vault API. In skip mode: verifies seed files exist.
steps.expectedOutput: Installer state prepared for the appropriate mode
interactions: seed: Verify or remove seed files based on mode

actions.code: (() => { if ('{{installerMode}}' === 'skip') return 'verify'; return 'delete'; })()
actions.description: Determine seed operation: verify in skip mode, delete in installer mode
Skip mode: verify seed files exist. Installer mode: remove seed files.

actions.code: (() => { if ('{{installerMode}}' !== 'installer') return 'skipped'; app.plugins.disablePlugin('{{PLUGIN_ID}}'); return 'disabling'; })()
(() => { if ('{{installerMode}}' !== 'installer') return 'ok'; if (app.plugins.plugins['{{PLUGIN_ID}}']) throw new Error('Plugin still loaded after disable'); return 'ok'; })()

(async () => { if ('{{installerMode}}' !== 'installer') return 'skipped'; const dp = '.obsidian/plugins/{{PLUGIN_ID}}/data.json'; const raw = await app.vault.adapter.read(dp); const data = JSON.parse(raw); data.installer = { installed: false, completedSteps: {} }; await app.vault.adapter.write(dp, JSON.stringify(data)); return 'reset'; })()

steps.title: Flowti plugin activates successfully
steps.description: Enables the Flowti IBDE plugin. In installer mode the wizard opens automatically; in skip mode the plugin loads normally.
steps.expectedOutput: Plugin is loaded and accessible via app.plugins.plugins

actions.code: app.plugins.enablePlugin('{{PLUGIN_ID}}')
(() => { if (!app.plugins.plugins['{{PLUGIN_ID}}']) throw new Error('Plugin not loaded after enable'); return 'ok'; })()

(() => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['{{PLUGIN_ID}}']; if (p && p.eventBus && !p._e2eEventTrace) { p._e2eEventTrace = []; p._e2ePerfTrace = []; p._e2eTraceUnsub = p.eventBus.on('*', (event) => { if (event.type.startsWith('log.')) return; if (event.type.startsWith('perf.')) { p._e2ePerfTrace.push({ type: event.type, ts: Date.now(), payload: JSON.stringify(event.payload ?? {}).substring(0, 500) }); return; } p._e2eEventTrace.push({ type: event.type, ts: Date.now(), payload: JSON.stringify(event.payload ?? {}).substring(0, 200) }); }); } return 'ok'; })()

(() => { const existing = app.workspace.getLeavesOfType('flowti-event-log')[0]; if (existing) { app.workspace.revealLeaf(existing); return 'ok'; } const leaf = app.workspace.getRightLeaf(false); if (leaf) leaf.setViewState({ type: 'flowti-event-log', active: true }); return 'ok'; })()
actions.description: Open Activity Log in right sidebar

steps.title: Plugin reports healthy state
steps.description: Inspects the plugin state snapshot: loaded=true, no errors, and at least one service registered.

actions.code: (() => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['{{PLUGIN_ID}}']; if (!p) throw new Error('Plugin not loaded'); const keys = Object.keys(p).filter(k => k.endsWith('Service')); if (keys.length === 0) throw new Error('No services registered'); return 'healthy (' + keys.length + ' services)'; })()
actions.description: Verify plugin is healthy with services

steps.title: EventBus is collecting events
steps.description: Verifies the plugin's EventBus is available and the E2E event trace array is initialized (started after plugin activation).
steps.expectedOutput: eventBus exists and _e2eEventTrace is an array

actions.code: (() => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['{{PLUGIN_ID}}']; if (!p?.eventBus) throw new Error('EventBus not available'); if (!Array.isArray(p._e2eEventTrace)) throw new Error('Event trace not initialized'); return 'ok'; })()
actions.description: Verify EventBus and trace array exist

steps.title: Flowti commands are registered
steps.description: Verifies the Flowti command pipeline is wired up by checking that the Activity Log view (opened after activation) is present in the right sidebar.
steps.expectedInput: Plugin loaded with registered commands, Activity Log opened
steps.expectedOutput: flowti-event-log leaf exists in the workspace

actions.code: (() => { const count = app.workspace.getLeavesOfType('flowti-event-log').length; if (count === 0) { try { app.commands.executeCommandById('{{PLUGIN_ID}}:flowti:open-event-log'); } catch(e) {} } return 'ok'; })()
actions.description: Verify Activity Log leaf exists (retry if needed)

steps.title: Required services are available
steps.description: Reads the plugin's registered service keys and verifies the essential services (userService, analyticsService, dataExchangeService) are present.
steps.expectedOutput: Service keys include userService, analyticsService, dataExchangeService

actions.code: (() => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['{{PLUGIN_ID}}']; const keys = Object.keys(p).filter(k => k.endsWith('Service')); const required = ['analyticsService', 'dataExchangeService', 'userService']; for (const svc of required) { if (!keys.includes(svc)) throw new Error('Missing required service: ' + svc); } return 'ok (' + keys.length + ' services)'; })()
